About the Team

The Strategic Accounts team’s mission is to make Miro the nerve center for innovation inside the world’s largest companies. We partner with Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises to help them accelerate product development, improve cross-functional alignment, and transform how teams move from strategy to execution.

This team sits at the center of Miro’s evolution from a collaboration product to an AI-powered innovation workspace. Our Strategic AEs operate as account CEOs, leading cross-functional account teams across Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Value Advisory, Professional Services, Product, Marketing, Partners, and executive leadership.

About the Role

Winning in Strategic Accounts is not about managing a territory or closing isolated deals. It is about building multi-year account strategies, identifying the customer’s most important business initiatives, and expanding Miro into mission-critical workflows across Product, Engineering, Design, IT, Operations, and transformation teams.

As a Strategic AE, you will own a focused portfolio of Miro’s largest enterprise customers. You will be expected to understand each account’s industry context, operating model, executive priorities, political landscape, renewal dynamics, and expansion potential. You will create pipeline through disciplined account-based execution, build executive alignment around measurable outcomes, and orchestrate Miro’s internal resources to turn strategic opportunities into durable enterprise partnerships.

What You’ll Do

→Own a portfolio of named strategic accounts

Develop and execute deep account strategies across 3–10 global enterprise customers. Identify priority business initiatives, critical workflows, executive buyers, Champions, renewal moments, competitive risks, and multi-product expansion opportunities.

→Drive workflow-led expansion

Position Miro around high-value enterprise workflows such as product strategy, roadmapping, customer discovery, prototyping, planning, agile execution, technical diagramming, portfolio visibility, and innovation governance. Connect Miro’s platform to measurable customer outcomes, including faster product cycles, stronger alignment, improved productivity, and better execution across distributed teams.

→Build executive alignment and business cases

Engage senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Design, IT, Transformation, Finance, and the C-suite. Create compelling business cases that tie Miro to named customer initiatives, quantified pain, strategic priorities, and long-term value realization.

→Orchestrate complex account teams

Lead cross-functional PODs across Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Value Advisory, Professional Services, Product, Marketing, Partners, BDRs, and senior leadership. Align the team around clear account objectives, executive engagement plans, validation events, and expansion plays.

→Create and manage strategic pipeline

Maintain a disciplined account-based pipeline generation motion. Use executive outreach, customer workshops, field marketing, partner collaboration, BDR support, and renewal planning to stay multiple quarters ahead on pipeline coverage.

→Operate with rigorous sales discipline

Apply MEDDPICC and Command of the Message at an expert level. Build customer-validated problem statements, develop real Champions, secure Economic Buyer access, quantify business impact, and use mutual plans to drive complex opportunities forward.

→Shape how Miro wins in the enterprise

Bring field intelligence back to Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and leadership. Help refine Miro’s enterprise narrative, identify repeatable expansion patterns, mentor peers, and contribute to regional go-to-market strategy.

What You’ll Need

10+ years of SaaS sales experience, including significant experience selling to Fortune 500 / Global 2000 enterprises with 10,000+ employees.

Proven track record of pipeline creation and deal closing through new business acquisition (Self-Sourcing / Outbound) in a B2B environment.

Proven success owning a small number of strategic named accounts and driving complex expansion motions across multiple business units, geographies, personas, and executive stakeholders.

Track record closing and expanding $250K–$1M+ enterprise opportunities, ideally including multi-product, multi-year, or transformation-oriented deals.

Strong ability to build executive relationships across Product, Engineering, Design, IT, Transformation, Finance, and C-level stakeholders.

Deep MEDDPICC and Command of the Message discipline, including strong qualification, Champion development, Economic Buyer engagement, quantified pain, decision-process management, and value-based selling.

Experience orchestrating cross-functional deal teams across SE, CS, Services, Value Advisory, Product, Marketing, Partners, BDRs, and executive sponsors.

Strong account planning discipline, with the ability to translate customer strategy into named initiatives, workflow opportunities, stakeholder maps, pipeline plans, and measurable expansion outcomes.

Comfort operating in complex, ambiguous enterprise environments where success requires persistence, business acumen, internal leadership, and the ability to create belief with both customers and internal teams.

AI fluency and curiosity, with a track record of leveraging AI tools to improve account research, stakeholder mapping, territory strategy, opportunity planning, customer insights, and overall sales productivity.

What's in it for you

We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. If you would like to learn more about location-specific benefits, please refer to our Global Miro benefits board.

About the team

The Customer Success Management team (CSM) is part of Customer Experience, which also includes Renewals and Support teams. CSMs work with our Enterprise-licensed customers to help them collaborate and innovate with Miro continuously, resulting in high retention and expansion rates.

 

About the role 

Miro is looking to hire a strategic Global Customer Success Leader to be responsible for building, coaching, and leading an amazing team of Customer Success managers and CSMs. Furthermore, you will partner closely with our regional Sales leaders and Professional Services leaders and other cross-functional partners to drive regional strategy, build senior executive relationships at our enterprise customers, ensure we drive value, and continuously improve adoption and retention.

 

What you’ll do

  • Build, coach and lead the Americas and Japan/Apac Customer Success teams 

  • Partner with sales leadership and other functions to improve customer lifetime value (CLV) through higher product adoption, customer value, health scores, customer satisfaction, retention and expansion

  • Drive the team to hit Key Performance Indicators 

  • Mentor the team to maintain account hygiene, health, and indicators

  • Participate in revenue and health forecasting

  • Partner with stakeholders to define and deliver on a best-in-class customer experience

  • Personally work with our largest customers (10K+ employee size) to establish executive relationships

  • Participate and contribute in formulating key strategic decisions as a part of the CS leadership team

  • As a senior leader you will continually demonstrate Miro’s behaviors and values to drive an inclusive and engaged culture

 

What you’ll need

  • 10+ years experience in Strategic or Enterprise (High Touch) Customer Success and/or Account Management leadership with a consistent track record of meeting targets

  • 7+years leading Customer Success and/or Account Management teams at high-growth B2B SaaS company

  • Have successfully lead Director level leaders in the past

  • Strong foundation in the Customer Success norms, processes, and KPIs

  • Excellent communication skills, ability to build relationships and work cross-functionally

  • Background of hiring, training, and enabling CSMs with strong performance management skills

  • Experience in working with Digital Customer Success and/or Marketing to drive CS at scale.

  • Experience driving professional services to deepen customer relationships and accelerate their time to value.

  • Excellent ability to identify and resolve problems in CS processes

  • Solid understanding of AI, Enterprise SaaS applications and collaboration technology

What's in it for you

About the Team

Our SMB and Commercial teams sit at the core of Miro's new business engine. SMB AEs work with small and scaling businesses — companies between 1 and 500 employees — in a fast-paced, high-volume environment where momentum matters. Commercial AEs work with mid-market companies from 500 to 3,000 employees — large enough to demand a real evaluation process, agile enough that the right champion can move a deal in weeks.

About the Team

The Professional Services organization at Miro is focused on ensuring our Enterprise customers achieve exceptional outcomes through the Innovation Workspace. Our team of strategic advisors, implementation experts, and forward deployed consultants work side-by-side with customers to transform how they collaborate, build, and innovate—powered by agentic AI and Miro's world-class platform.

 

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Consultant, Manufacturing, you will apply AI solutions to transform and automate the core operating processes of leading industrial enterprises. You will engage directly with C-level executives, help them identify high-impact opportunities, build and test enterprise-grade AI solutions on their own data and systems, and drive measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology. You will be paired with an Account Executive against named accounts—hunting for problems worth solving, then proving they can be solved. Generalist FDCs lead client discussions across industries; as the Manufacturing Specialist, you are the dedicated depth they bring in when a pursuit turns on industrial expertise.

What you’ll do

Executive Agenda:

  • Partner with senior executives—COO, Chief Supply Chain Officer, Chief Digital Officer, VP Manufacturing, VP Quality—to define an AI transformation agenda Miro can attach to

  • Lead the initial CxO conversation that creates awareness of what AI makes possible for the business

  • Qualify opportunities before committing to a Validation Sprint: sponsor authority, commitment, and the account's potential to become a multi-year, seven-figure relationship

Validation Sprints:

  • Co-author the Sprint charter with the AE: the business problem, its value, our approach, exit criteria, and the partnership proposal that follows success

  • Run the Sprint end to end—immerse, prioritise, build, read out—developing and testing the solution on the customer's real data and systems

  • Take manufacturing processes apart and rebuild them on AI-first principles across five workflows: new product development and gate review, quality and continuous improvement, portfolio and program management, operations and launch readiness, and process development and transformation

  • Build using Miro's AI Workflows, Prototypes, and Goals, Roadmaps & Delivery capabilities, extended through Miro's API, WebSDK, and MCP integrations into ERP, PLM, MES, and quality systems

Value and Conversion:

  • Turn Sprint outcomes into a business value story, ROI model, and KPI baseline—grounded in metrics the customer already runs on: gate cycle time, requirement coverage at gate, defect recurrence, cost of poor quality, capacity utilisation, on-time launch rate, ramp-to-full-rate time

  • Support executive leadership in delivering the Value Story read-out to the sponsor

  • Co-own with the AE the conversion of Sprint outcomes into the partnership proposal and commercial approach

  • Define the scope of Professional Services involvement post-sale and hand over cleanly

  • Package what you learn and radiate it—internally to Sales, Marketing, and Product, and externally through thought leadership

 

What you’ll need

  • 8+ years in top-tier consulting, forward deployed engineering, solution consulting, or enterprise transformation, weighted toward manufacturing and industrial environments

  • Deep understanding of manufacturing operating processes: NPI and stage-gate/APQP, engineering change management, quality systems (FMEA, 8D, PPAP), S&OP and production planning, lean and continuous improvement, maintenance and reliability

  • Fluency with the industrial enterprise stack—ERP (SAP or equivalent), PLM (Teamcenter, Windchill, 3DEXPERIENCE), MES, quality management systems—and where the data lives

  • Credibility with COO, Chief Supply Chain Officer, VP Operations, VP Quality, and Plant General Manager stakeholders

  • Exceptional GenAI skills: Miro, Cursor, Claude Code and Cowork, ChatGPT, Google and Microsoft suites, MCP integrations, prompt and context engineering. You can build working solutions yourself and orchestrate an AI Engineer when the build demands it

  • Ability to build a before/after value story with financial and ROI analysis that survives finance scrutiny

  • A business-problem-first rather than product-first mindset, and the curiosity to take any process apart

  • Comfort in both the boardroom and the plant

  • Self-starter who operates independently and under ambiguity

  • Willing to travel to customer sites up to 40%

What's in it for you

We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. If you would like to learn more about location-specific benefits, please refer to our Global Miro benefits board.

About the Team

The Commercial (Mid-Market) Sales Team is pivotal to our go-to-market strategy, driving growth by acquiring new customers and expanding existing accounts. As a Commercial Account Executive on this team, you will join a dynamic, high-performing group that thrives on innovation and collaboration while championing Miro’s mission to empower teams to build the next big thing. Our team balances ambitious goals with a supportive and fun culture, where success is celebrated, and personal growth is encouraged. 

 

About the Role

As a Commercial Account Executive, you will expand our footprint by engaging companies with 500 to 3,000 employees across a wide range of verticals and industries. At Miro, we support a vast number of use cases & solutions that are rapidly evolving with the pace of AI. As a result, there’s no standardized, one-size fits all playbook to follow. People that succeed here are excited by the ability to help build new strategies and approaches, have the autonomy to try new things, and the ownership that comes with influencing the future of the company as we evolve from a single-product to multi-product company.

About the Team

The Strategic Accounts team’s mission is to make Miro the nerve center for innovation inside the world’s largest companies. We partner with Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises to help them accelerate product development, improve cross-functional alignment, and transform how teams move from strategy to execution.

This team sits at the center of Miro’s evolution from a collaboration product to an AI-powered innovation workspace. Our Strategic AEs operate as account CEOs, leading cross-functional account teams across Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Value Advisory, Professional Services, Product, Marketing, Partners, and executive leadership.

About the Role

Winning in Strategic Accounts is not about managing a territory or closing isolated deals. It is about building multi-year account strategies, identifying the customer’s most important business initiatives, and expanding Miro into mission-critical workflows across Product, Engineering, Design, IT, Operations, and transformation teams.

As a Strategic AE, you will own a focused portfolio of Miro’s largest enterprise customers. You will be expected to understand each account’s industry context, operating model, executive priorities, political landscape, renewal dynamics, and expansion potential. You will create pipeline through disciplined account-based execution, build executive alignment around measurable outcomes, and orchestrate Miro’s internal resources to turn strategic opportunities into durable enterprise partnerships.

What you’ll do

→Own a portfolio of named strategic accounts

Develop and execute deep account strategies across 3–10 global enterprise customers. Identify priority business initiatives, critical workflows, executive buyers, Champions, renewal moments, competitive risks, and multi-product expansion opportunities.

→Drive workflow-led expansion

Position Miro around high-value enterprise workflows such as product strategy, roadmapping, customer discovery, prototyping, planning, agile execution, technical diagramming, portfolio visibility, and innovation governance. Connect Miro’s platform to measurable customer outcomes, including faster product cycles, stronger alignment, improved productivity, and better execution across distributed teams.

→Build executive alignment and business cases

Engage senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Design, IT, Transformation, Finance, and the C-suite. Create compelling business cases that tie Miro to named customer initiatives, quantified pain, strategic priorities, and long-term value realization.

→Orchestrate complex account teams

Lead cross-functional PODs across Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Value Advisory, Professional Services, Product, Marketing, Partners, BDRs, and senior leadership. Align the team around clear account objectives, executive engagement plans, validation events, and expansion plays.

→Create and manage strategic pipeline

Maintain a disciplined account-based pipeline generation motion. Use executive outreach, customer workshops, field marketing, partner collaboration, BDR support, and renewal planning to stay multiple quarters ahead on pipeline coverage.

→Operate with rigorous sales discipline

Apply MEDDPICC and Command of the Message at an expert level. Build customer-validated problem statements, develop real Champions, secure Economic Buyer access, quantify business impact, and use mutual plans to drive complex opportunities forward.

→Shape how Miro wins in the enterprise

Bring field intelligence back to Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and leadership. Help refine Miro’s enterprise narrative, identify repeatable expansion patterns, mentor peers, and contribute to regional go-to-market strategy.

What you’ll need

  • 10+ years of SaaS sales experience, including significant experience selling to Fortune 500 / Global 2000 enterprises with 10,000+ employees.

  • Native level proficiency in Spanish and English

  • Proven success owning a small number of strategic named accounts and driving complex expansion motions across multiple business units, geographies, personas, and executive stakeholders.

  • Track record closing and expanding $250K–$1M+ enterprise opportunities, ideally including multi-product, multi-year, or transformation-oriented deals.

  • Strong ability to build executive relationships across Product, Engineering, Design, IT, Transformation, Finance, and C-level stakeholders.

  • Deep MEDDPICC and Command of the Message discipline, including strong qualification, Champion development, Economic Buyer engagement, quantified pain, decision-process management, and value-based selling.

  • Experience orchestrating cross-functional deal teams across SE, CS, Services, Value Advisory, Product, Marketing, Partners, BDRs, and executive sponsors.

  • Strong account planning discipline, with the ability to translate customer strategy into named initiatives, workflow opportunities, stakeholder maps, pipeline plans, and measurable expansion outcomes.

  • Comfort operating in complex, ambiguous enterprise environments where success requires persistence, business acumen, internal leadership, and the ability to create belief with both customers and internal teams.

  • AI fluency and curiosity, with a track record of leveraging AI tools to improve account research, stakeholder mapping, territory strategy, opportunity planning, customer insights, and overall sales productivity.

What's in it for you

We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. If you would like to learn more about location-specific benefits, please refer to our Global Miro benefits board.

About the Team

The Innovation Architect sits within Miro's Professional Services organization, specifically inside the MOST (Miro Optimization Services & Training) program. MOST is Miro's subscription-based PS offering for enterprise customers. Each customer gets 240 hours per year to work with Miro experts on designing, implementing, and scaling how their teams collaborate. Innovation Architects work alongside Customer Success Managers, Technical Architects, and Engagement Managers to deliver structured, outcomes-driven engagements across some of Miro's most complex accounts.

 

About the Role

Enterprise customers have the hours. What they often don't have is someone who can translate where they want to go into a concrete, sequenced plan for getting there inside Miro. That's the gap this role fills.

The Innovation Architect is the strategic and architectural layer of a MOST engagement. They run discovery, diagnose how teams actually work today, design the governance and collaboration infrastructure to support where the customer is heading, and build the roadmap for how 240 hours get used across the year. They also own AI workflow advisory, helping customers move from ad hoc Miro usage to intelligent, repeatable collaboration systems.


This role is open because the program is growing and the complexity of enterprise accounts has outpaced what CSMs and Technical Architects can absorb on top of their core scope. The right candidate has a consulting background, is fluent in collaboration platforms, and is comfortable running live discovery with a skeptical CTO and a frustrated Product Lead at the same time. They own delivery quality from day one.

What you’ll do

  • Own the solution roadmap for a portfolio of MOST accounts: run structured discovery, map the customer's operating model, and design a sequenced 240-hour plan tied directly to their business outcomes

  • Architect end-to-end Miro implementations covering workspace governance, access models, naming conventions, and lifecycle management for organizations operating at scale

  • Lead AI workflow advisory as a core workstream: diagnose collaboration inefficiencies and build intelligent, automated solutions using Miro's AI capabilities and adjacent platform integrations

  • Facilitate executive and cross-functional working sessions including Agile planning, design thinking, strategy, and innovation workshops

  • Drive adoption through change management: stakeholder alignment, communication planning, phased rollouts, and hands-on coaching on Miro best practices

  • Track progress against defined outcomes across the full subscription lifecycle, surface risks early, and adjust the plan as priorities shift

  • Contribute reusable delivery assets (templates, frameworks, playbooks) that raise the consistency floor across PS and reduce time-to-value for future engagements

 

What you’ll need

  • 6+ years in consulting, change management, Agile transformation, or professional services supporting enterprise organizations

  • Experience leading structured discovery with VP-level and above stakeholders and turning ambiguous findings into a clear, prioritized plan

  • Working knowledge of collaboration governance: workspace architecture, access models, naming conventions, and lifecycle management at enterprise scale

  • Fluency in Miro or a comparable collaboration platform (Figma, Lucid, Confluence, JIRA)

  • Hands-on experience designing AI-powered workflow optimization: automation, prompt-based workflows, or AI-assisted tooling in an enterprise environment

  • Able to simplify complex governance and architecture topics for non-technical audiences without losing the thread

  • Comfortable working across IT, Product, Design, Strategy, and PMO simultaneously, often with conflicting stakeholder priorities

  • Strong technical fluency: familiarity with APIs, integrations and enterprise IT ecosystems.

What's in it for you

We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. MOST is Miro’s annual professional services subscription designed for enterprise customers who need ongoing, flexible access to expert guidance—not a one-time project.
Customers receive 240 hours per year of services to help them design, implement, and scale collaboration solutions in Miro across teams, functions, and geographies.

In this role, the Innovation Architect partners with customers to translate business strategy into scalable collaboration architectures inside Miro.
This includes diagnosing workflow and adoption challenges, designing governance and operating models, and shaping a structured, outcomes-driven solution roadmap that evolves as customer needs change.

Innovation Architects operate as trusted advisors to both business and technical stakeholders.
They design end-to-end collaboration solutions by combining process design, workspace architecture, governance, and enablement to ensure customers achieve measurable value from Miro

What you'll do

  • Lead discovery to understand customer goals, workflows, and pain points; translate findings into a structured MOST game plan aligned to their 240-hour allocation

  • Facilitate vision, alignment, and prioritization sessions to help customers define outcomes, success criteria, and adoption milestones

  • Conduct collaboration, workflow, and workspace assessments; synthesize insights and provide clear recommendations for improvement

  • Design and implement governance frameworks (workspace structure, naming, access, lifecycle, templates) that reduce risk and support long-term scalability

  • Guide customers through change-management initiatives, including communication plans, stakeholder alignment, and rollout sequencing

  • Coach teams on Miro best practices, intelligent templates, AI workflows, and techniques to streamline planning, retrospectives, decision-making, and cross-functional work

  • Facilitate workshops across Agile ceremonies, product development, innovation, research, design thinking, and strategy development

  • Build lightweight prototypes, templates, and reusable workflows that accelerate customer adoption and demonstrate the art of the possible

  • Partner with IT/Admin stakeholders to establish standards, reduce tool sprawl, and drive consistency in workspace setup and governance

  • Recommend process optimizations that increase operational efficiency, improve collaboration quality, and reduce context switching

  • Provide ongoing advisory support throughout the MOST subscription, updating forecasts, adjusting plans, and ensuring hours are used strategically

  • Track progress against milestones and outcomes; flag risks early and help customers re-prioritize work as business needs evolve

  • Collaborate with CSMs, Architects, and Engagement Managers to ensure consistent delivery and alignment across customer stakeholders

  • Contribute to internal playbooks, templates, and delivery assets that improve team leverage and delivery efficiency across Professional Services

  • Stay current on Miro innovations, AI features, and collaboration trends to continuously uplevel customer guidance

What you'll need

  • 6+ years in consulting, change management, Agile transformation, digital collaboration, or similar fields

  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale teams through workflow, process, or tool adoption initiatives

  • Proven ability to lead structured discovery, synthesize insights, and define actionable recommendations

  • Strong record of enabling cross-functional teams (IT, Product, Design, Strategy, PMO, Engineering) to adopt new tools or improve collaboration maturity

Technical Skills:

  • Familiarity with collaboration governance frameworks, workspace architecture, and lifecycle management

  • Experience with Human-Centered Design, Agile methodologies, Design Thinking, or innovation frameworks

  • Fluency in Miro (preferred) or similar platforms (Figma, Lucid, JIRA, Confluence)

  • Ability to map workflows, diagnose adoption barriers, and design scalable collaboration systems

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management ability

  • Skilled at simplifying complexity and driving clarity with senior and cross-functional audiences

  • Adaptable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in dynamic, ambiguous environments

  • Language: Near-native proficiency in Japanese and business-level English proficiency sufficient for internal communication, including meetings and discussions

What's in it for you

We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. About the Role

Miro is looking for an exceptional General Manager to lead our Japan business. Japan is one of Miro's fastest-growing markets, and that growth is about to accelerate: we've made a significant recent investment in a Japan Data Center, removing a long-standing barrier for enterprise customers and opening the door to a new tier of commercial ambition.

This is a business catalyst role. We need a senior executive who can drive an ambitious commercial agenda while building a team and culture strong enough to carry it, for our people and for the customers we serve. This person earns trust quickly, leads with transparency, and represents Japan credibly inside a global organization while being the external face of Miro Japan.

You'll lead a team that understands customers' most strategic challenges, knows exactly who the key stakeholders are, and helps those customers transform their business with Miro, all while building a Tokyo hub that people are proud to belong to.

What you’ll do

Commercial Leadership
● Set the strategy for Japan's High Touch Sales organization and own its execution
with clear accountability.
● Own an ambitious, sustainable growth target for the region.
● Win new logos, particularly lighthouse accounts, and drive wall-to-wall expansion
across the existing customer base.
● Build effective co-sell motions with partners: new logo acquisition into TSE-listed
parent companies, and expansion into their subsidiaries.
● Act as a trusted Miro expert for enterprise customers, credible with practitioners
and executives alike.

People & Culture Leadership
● Build a Tokyo hub culture grounded in transparency, strong team dynamics,
accountability, and psychological safety.
● Lead and develop a multi-layered team, visibly investing in coaching and growth.
● Act as a genuine bridge between Japan and JAPAC/global leadership, translating
strategy and context in both directions.
● Be an active, engaged member of the regional senior leadership team as well as
the cross functional global leadership team.
● Hold the standard we hold every leader to: how you lead people matters as much
as the results you deliver.

What you’ll need

Experience & Track Record
● 15+ years of experience across direct and partner-led sales.
● A proven track record in direct SaaS sales within enterprise segments.
● A demonstrable partner sales track record, including co-sell motions for new logo
acquisition and subsidiary expansion into TSE-listed groups.
● Experience leading through a layer of management, leading people managers
rather than only individual contributors, across a growing team of 20+.
● Country Manager or GM experience in a global company is a strong plus, as is a
background in SaaS, PLG, or collaboration software.

Leadership & Culture
● A track record of building trust with your team, stakeholders, peers, and
customers.
● Demonstrated ability to build or turn around team culture, backed by concrete
examples of impact.
● Strong experience operating in a global, matrixed organization and working well
amid ambiguity.
● A consistent, accountable, and transparent leadership style.
● A genuine investment in developing talent, evidenced by people on your team
who grew and excelled under your leadership.

What's in it for you

About the Team

The Strategic Accounts team’s mission is to make Miro the nerve center for innovation inside the world’s largest companies. We partner with Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises to help them accelerate product development, improve cross-functional alignment, and transform how teams move from strategy to execution.

This team sits at the center of Miro’s evolution from a collaboration product to an AI-powered innovation workspace. Our Strategic AEs operate as account CEOs, leading cross-functional account teams across Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Value Advisory, Professional Services, Product, Marketing, Partners, and executive leadership.

About the Role

Winning in Strategic Accounts is not about managing a territory or closing isolated deals. It is about building multi-year account strategies, identifying the customer’s most important business initiatives, and expanding Miro into mission-critical workflows across Product, Engineering, Design, IT, Operations, and transformation teams.

As a Strategic AE, you will own a focused portfolio of Miro’s largest enterprise customers. You will be expected to understand each account’s industry context, operating model, executive priorities, political landscape, renewal dynamics, and expansion potential. You will create pipeline through disciplined account-based execution, build executive alignment around measurable outcomes, and orchestrate Miro’s internal resources to turn strategic opportunities into durable enterprise partnerships.

What You’ll Do

→Own a portfolio of named strategic accounts

Develop and execute deep account strategies across 3–10 global enterprise customers. Identify priority business initiatives, critical workflows, executive buyers, Champions, renewal moments, competitive risks, and multi-product expansion opportunities.

→Drive workflow-led expansion

Position Miro around high-value enterprise workflows such as product strategy, roadmapping, customer discovery, prototyping, planning, agile execution, technical diagramming, portfolio visibility, and innovation governance. Connect Miro’s platform to measurable customer outcomes, including faster product cycles, stronger alignment, improved productivity, and better execution across distributed teams.

→Build executive alignment and business cases

Engage senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Design, IT, Transformation, Finance, and the C-suite. Create compelling business cases that tie Miro to named customer initiatives, quantified pain, strategic priorities, and long-term value realization.

→Orchestrate complex account teams

Lead cross-functional PODs across Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Value Advisory, Professional Services, Product, Marketing, Partners, BDRs, and senior leadership. Align the team around clear account objectives, executive engagement plans, validation events, and expansion plays.

→Create and manage strategic pipeline

Maintain a disciplined account-based pipeline generation motion. Use executive outreach, customer workshops, field marketing, partner collaboration, BDR support, and renewal planning to stay multiple quarters ahead on pipeline coverage.

→Operate with rigorous sales discipline

Apply MEDDPICC and Command of the Message at an expert level. Build customer-validated problem statements, develop real Champions, secure Economic Buyer access, quantify business impact, and use mutual plans to drive complex opportunities forward.

→Shape how Miro wins in the enterprise

Bring field intelligence back to Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and leadership. Help refine Miro’s enterprise narrative, identify repeatable expansion patterns, mentor peers, and contribute to regional go-to-market strategy.

What You’ll Need

10+ years of SaaS sales experience, including significant experience selling to Fortune 500 / Global 2000 enterprises with 10,000+ employees.

Proven track record of pipeline creation and deal closing through new business acquisition (Self-Sourcing / Outbound) in a B2B environment.

Proven success owning a small number of strategic named accounts and driving complex expansion motions across multiple business units, geographies, personas, and executive stakeholders.

Track record closing and expanding $250K–$1M+ enterprise opportunities, ideally including multi-product, multi-year, or transformation-oriented deals.

Strong ability to build executive relationships across Product, Engineering, Design, IT, Transformation, Finance, and C-level stakeholders.

Deep MEDDPICC and Command of the Message discipline, including strong qualification, Champion development, Economic Buyer engagement, quantified pain, decision-process management, and value-based selling.

Experience orchestrating cross-functional deal teams across SE, CS, Services, Value Advisory, Product, Marketing, Partners, BDRs, and executive sponsors.

Strong account planning discipline, with the ability to translate customer strategy into named initiatives, workflow opportunities, stakeholder maps, pipeline plans, and measurable expansion outcomes.

Comfort operating in complex, ambiguous enterprise environments where success requires persistence, business acumen, internal leadership, and the ability to create belief with both customers and internal teams.

AI fluency and curiosity, with a track record of leveraging AI tools to improve account research, stakeholder mapping, territory strategy, opportunity planning, customer insights, and overall sales productivity.

What's in it for you

We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. If you would like to learn more about location-specific benefits, please refer to our Global Miro benefits board.
